evidence: Manual forms and authored offline tests; no controller or native task execution

sources.topic: ERROR, POWERUP, SEMAPHORE and miscellaneous handler actions; EVAL capture
CLEAR_SEMA, PEND_SEMA, POST_ERR, POST_ERR_L severity names/scopes, POST_SEMA and SEMA_COUNT signatures

implemented.semaphores: Explicit bank count; zero initial unspecified counters; FIFO wait tickets, atomic posting/consumption and negative queued-wait counts
implemented.waits: -1 indefinite, 0 immediate or positive milliseconds up to one day; BOOLEAN timeout; scheduler virtual clock or standalone 1 ms sleeper polling
implemented.cleanup: Stop/abort/failure removes waits, refunds unconsumed grants and preserves unrelated waiters by identity; active waits cannot be serialized
implemented.errors: POST_ERR code/parameter/cause/severity 0 warning, 1 global context pause, 2 global context abort; bounded defensive ErrorHistory
implemented.scoped_errors: POST_ERR_L portable ERSEV identifiers 0..10, normalized warning/pause/abort, explicit root-task or shared-context scope; persisted operation, severity_name and posting source_program
implemented.requests: Named/numeric remote pause/abort queued for target checkpoint; paused scheduler abort wakes to scan handlers; self identity follows linked caller; synchronous child intentional ABORT/STOP returns to caller
implemented.conditions: ERROR[n] and wildcard consume retained scoped records independently; POWERUP is an explicit recovery continuation; SEMAPHORE is non-consuming
implemented.actions: NOPAUSE and NOABORT clear pending control requests, including linked calls; NOMESSAGE marks retained history; EVAL actions capture at definition
implemented.runtime_failures: Cooperative KarelRuntimeError notifies code 1 with origin runtime after unwinding, then remains an exception; exhausted budgets skip handler execution
implemented.powerup: Program.powerup or scheduler.powerup continues a live paused instance and increments POWERUP plus CONTINUE; no lost-process restoration
implemented.signals: EVENT and SEMAPHORE signals and self CONTINUE (bare or numeric) scan at their trailing checkpoint even as the final source statement

portable_differences: Record/event generations latch and coalesce until scanned, unlike native ephemeral error/event scans
Runtime code 1 is an offline category without a native alarm mapping; no automatic retry or continuation after invalid runtime values
CLEAR_SEMA preserves queued waits and granted reservations; no native cancellation assertion
FIFO ordering, one-day bounds, polling quantum and ticket refund rules are portable conventions
POST_ERR global scope includes only active/paused registered Programs in one context; no motion or native alarm dictionary
ERSEV names follow manual forms but IDs are portable 0..10, not verified native encodings; STOP/SERVO variants normalize to offline pause and SYSTEM to global abort without controller lockout
PAUSE_TASK/ABORT_TASK accept no_wait but both values queue the same request; no native acknowledgment wait
Scheduler raises at its first abort; remaining pending requests require the next drive; paused standalone targets require continuation
NOMESSAGE preserves the suppressed audit record, rather than deleting history
Handlers run sequentially with ordinary Pythonic actions; no native interrupt priority or routine-action ordering equivalence
